info.title: Examance API
info.description:
Privacy-first anonymous exam grading backend.

## Key Security & Architecture Features
- **Zero-Knowledge Encryption**: Student PII, submission scans, and annotations are encrypted client-side (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM) before reaching the server.
- **Session Hygiene**: State stored in HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` 15 min, `refresh_token` 7 days with rotation & reuse detection).
- **Privacy Safeguards**: LaTeX requests redacted in logs (`LaTeXRequest`), IP addresses stored as SHA-256 hashes, k-anonymity (k >= 5) enforced on class stats.
- **LaTeX Engine**: Compilation rendered using sandboxed Tectonic (`tectonic --untrusted`).

post.description:
Create a teacher account.

Requires a valid, unexpired, unused invite_token.
On success, sets auth cookies and returns { email, role }.

Verify credentials, set httpOnly access + refresh cookies.

Response body contains only { email, role } — never the token value.

Issue new access + refresh cookies, revoke the old refresh token.

Detects concurrent use (token theft) if the token is already revoked.
Clear auth cookies and revoke refresh token.

Compile LaTeX source to PDF via Tectonic.

Rate limited: 10 req/min per IP.
Body limit: 2 MB (enforced by BodyLimitMiddleware).
LaTeX source is NEVER logged — see LaTeXRequest.__repr__ and latex service.

with a 7-day retention grace period before hard deletion.

LaTeX exercise templates and exam structures remain intact.
